In the immediate foreground, there are two hockey pucks. The puck on the left is white with red and black graphics/text, while the puck on the right is standard black with a logo. The background is solid black.

The objects appear solid and opaque with the expected geometric form of a hockey puck.

While one puck is black, the other prominent puck is white. Furthermore, the black puck shows significant specular highlights suggesting a semi-gloss or plastic finish rather than the characteristic matte vulcanized rubber.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both pucks feature printed graphics. The white puck has complex red/black branding, and the black puck has a white/red logo.

The circumferential edge of the white puck lacks the defining ridges/grooves of a real puck, appearing as a perfectly smooth, featureless band, which is a structural deviation from the class definition.
The text on the white puck is stylized and partially illegible/distorted, typical of AI generation struggling with small, curved typography.
